\begin{example} \end{example}[Hamilton--Jacobi Equation]

↗ def:kth-order-pde ↗ def:linear-semilinear-quasilinear-fully-nonlinear

1. ch1:1.2.1.b.6\group Examples of PDE

\[ u_t + H(Du, x) = 0. \] This is first-order. If $H$ is nonlinear in its first argument, the equation is fully nonlinear; in particular, $H(p,x)=|p|^2$ gives $u_t+|Du|^2=0$, whose symbol is quadratic rather than affine in $Du$. \end{example}
